title: SLAyiNG: Towards Queer Language Processing

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias (Queer language bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating a language model's (o3-mini) comprehension of queer slang through a word sense disambiguation task, calculating inter-annotator agreement between the model and human experts to measure the model's representation and understanding of LGBTQ+ sociolects.

primary_bias_target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias (Queer language bias)
